description: GET /context/inspect answers with `presigned_url`, a time-limited signed URL (spec example `https://storage.hydradb.com/sources/HydraDoc1234?sig=...`) that downloads the stored source content without the API key for up to `expiry_seconds` (60 s to 7 days). It is a bearer credential for the content, but the spec carries no sensitive mark, so the SDK would hand it back as a plain string that ends up in logs and traces. Source: the `fetch.V2SourceFetchResponse.presigned_url` description and example in https://docs.hydradb.com/api-reference/v2/openapi.json (fetched 2026-11-14).
